alwaysPullBeforeWorktree: Always pull before creating a new worktree
branchTemplateIssueKey: Alias for ticket. Use whichever name reads better in your template.
branchTemplateLiteralPrefix: Write literal prefixes directly, for example <0>{{example}}</0>.

cleanupScriptHelp: Runs when the task is completed to clean up the workspace.
copyFilesHelp: Gitignored paths copied into new worktrees. Append <0>{{symlink}}</0> to an entry to link it back to the main repo. Use <1>{{escapedSymlink}}</1> for a literal filename ending in <2>{{symlink}}</2>.
copyFilesPathsResolved: Paths are resolved relative to the repository root and seeded into every new worktree, preserving their relative location. Existing files in the worktree are not overwritten.
copyFilesPatternGlobstar: <0>{{globstar}}</0> matches any number of directories, e.g. <1>{{example}}</1>
copyFilesPatternLiteral: <0>{{pattern}}</0> literal file or directory (directories copy recursively)
copyFilesRemoteFallback: Remote executors copy file contents instead of creating symlinks.
copyFilesSizeLimit: Files over {{limit}} are skipped when copying to remote executors. Local worktrees copy them without a size cap.
deleteRepositoryConfirm: This will remove the repository and its scripts. This action cannot be undone.
deleteRepositoryActiveSessions_one: This repository is used by {{count}} active agent session. Stop or finish it before deleting the repository.
deleteRepositoryActiveSessions_other: This repository is used by {{count}} active agent sessions. Stop or finish them before deleting the repository.
